findings.rationale: Real contradiction. Resolved by intent, not by exempting foremen: the reserve MUST apply to the default 40 cap, because foremen cut off before commit are the reported harm. §2.5 is reworded (cap value unchanged at 40; its last effective-reserve calls admit only the allowlist) and KR4 now names the cap-loop assertions as allowed re-expectations.

Same root as 0ee6b400. KR4 and the §2.5 test rule now allow the existing Bash-cap loop in foreman-guard.test.sh to be re-expected: calls inside the reserve use allowlisted commands or expect the reserve deny. Each changed assertion is listed in the commit message and none is deleted.
Folded: `cd <path>` is added as an allowlisted segment so `cd repo && git commit` passes in the reserve.

The plan segments the output of the existing executableText(), which drops heredoc BODIES before any split (hooks/foreman-guard.js executableText). Only the introducer line `cat > file <<EOF` remains, and it matches the `cat >` write form. A test case is added for it anyway.

Folded: no role cache. The role is re-derived from the child's first transcript line on every call (a bounded 64 KiB read). The state file holds only counters, so a child editing it can at most change counts, not claim a role.
Folded: non-string `message.content` (for example an array of blocks) is pinned to the foreman fallback, and a test covers it.
Folded: GC runs at most once per hour per store (stamp file), is bounded to 500 entries per pass, and swallows every error inside its own try/catch.
Already specified: P3 states that the one fixed reserve directive, which names the allowed verbs, is used 'both for entry and for every reserve denial'. That includes the allowed entry call.

Valid and important: docs say additionalContext is 'passed to Claude' but do not prove delivery INSIDE a subagent. Folded into P1 as a live acceptance probe (a subagent must echo a nonce injected via additionalContext on an allowed Bash call). Fallback if it fails: advisories and reserve entry are delivered as the reason of a deny instead, since deny reasons are documented to reach the model, and P4 is dropped.
